finding: NEAR-PAPERLESS BURST. Zero refereed papers ANALYZE GRB 191125A / bn191125206; the single refereed appearance (Mangano+2021) is an instrument-demonstration light curve with no measurements. The GCN record is one auto-generated circular (26292). The external comparison frame for the P3 diff is therefore the GBM online catalog (bcat/tcat/scat FITS from HEASARC FTP bursts/2019/bn191125206/current/, fetched 2026-08-11): T90=77.31+/-0.81 s (50-300 keV, T90START=1.79 s), fluence(10-1000 keV)=4.967e-5 erg/cm2, flnc Comp Ep=915.6-83/+97 keV index=-1.4625+/-0.012 (dets n1,n3,n5,b0, interval -1.024..115.712 s, PSTAT), Band beta RAILED at -2.0001 in both flnc and pflx fits - all filed in the dossier's PUBLISHED VALUES section and in the P0 freeze.
